H0568I.name: Amariah
H0568I.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0568I.brief: Levite, descendant of Hebron, during David's reign
H0568I.short: Amariah was a Levite, a descendant of Hebron, who served during the reign of King David.

H0568H.name: Amariah
H0568H.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0568H.brief: High priest, ancestor of Ezra the scribe
H0568H.short: Amariah was a high priest during the reign of Jehoshaphat and an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

H0568G.name: Amariah
H0568G.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H0568G.brief: Ancestor of Zadok the priest, in Aaron's line
H0568G.short: Amariah, son of Meraioth, was an ancestor of Zadok the priest and a descendant of Aaron through his son Eleazar.

H0568J.name: Amariah
H0568J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0568J.brief: Chief priest under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H0568J.short: Amariah was the chief priest who assisted King Jehoshaphat in his judicial reforms in Judah.

H0568K.name: Amariah
H0568K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0568K.brief: Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah
H0568K.short: Amariah was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

H0568L.name: Amariah
H0568L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0568L.brief: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
H0568L.short: Amariah was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

H0568M.name: Amariah
H0568M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0568M.brief: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and served as chief priest
H0568M.short: Amariah was a priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and later served as a chief priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H0568N.name: Amariah
H0568N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0568N.short: Amariah, a descendant of Judah through Perez, was among those chosen to resettle in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H0568O.name: Amariah
H0568O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0568O.short: Amariah was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

H0558H.name: Amaziah
H0558H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0558H.short: Amaziah, the son of Joshah, was a descendant of Simeon.

H0558I.name: Amaziah
H0558I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0558I.short: Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah, was a Levite of the family of Merari during the time of David.

H0558G.name: Amaziah
H0558G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0558G.brief: King of Judah, son of Joash
H0558G.short: Amaziah, son of Joash, was the ninth king of Judah who reigned for 29 years.

H0558J.name: Amaziah
H0558J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0558J.brief: Priest of Bethel during Amos' ministry
H0558J.short: Amaziah, the priest of Bethel, opposed the prophet Amos and told him to leave the kingdom of Israel.

H0532.name: Ami
H0532.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0532.short: The descendants of Ami (or Amon) were among the returned exiles who were servants of Solomon.

H0573.name: Amittai
H0573.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0573.short: Amittai was the father of Jonah, the prophet from Gath-hepher.

H0550H.name: Amnon
H0550H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0550H.brief: Son of Shimon, descendant of Judah
H0550H.short: Amnon was a son of Shimon and a descendant of Judah.

H0550G.name: Amnon
H0550G.desc: David's son living at the time of United Monarchy
H0550G.brief: David's firstborn son, killed by Absalom
H0550G.short: Amnon, David's firstborn son, raped his half-sister Tamar and was later killed by her brother Absalom.

H0526G.name: Amon
H0526G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0526G.brief: Governor of Samaria during Ahab's reign
H0526G.short: Amon was the governor of Samaria during the reign of King Ahab of Israel.

H0526H.name: Amon
H0526H.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0526H.brief: King of Judah, son of Manasseh
H0526H.short: Amon, the son of Manasseh, was the 15th king of Judah who reigned for two years before being assassinated by his servants.

H0567.name: Amorites
H0567.brief: Canaanite people group, enemies of Israel
H0567.short: The Amorites were a Canaanite people group who lived in the hill country and were among the enemies the Israelites faced when entering the Promised Land.

H0531.name: Amoz
H0531.desc: Isaiah's father living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0531.short: Amoz, the father of the prophet Isaiah.

H0569.name: Amraphel
H0569.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0569.brief: King of Shinar, ally of Chedorlaomer
H0569.short: Amraphel, king of Shinar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the Plain.
H0569.meaning: “sayer of darkness: fall of the sayer”

forms.meaning: “sayer of darkness: fall of the sayer”

H0557G.name: Amzi
H0557G.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0557G.short: Amzi, a descendant of Merari, was a Levite who served as a musician in the temple.

H0557H.name: Amzi
H0557H.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H0557H.brief: Priest in Jerusalem after the Exile
H0557H.short: Amzi was a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H0593.name: Aniam
H0593.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0593.brief: Son of Shemida, descendant of Manasseh
H0593.short: Aniam was a son of Shemida and a descendant of Manasseh, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh.
H0593.meaning: “I am the people” or “lament of people”

forms.meaning: “I am the people” or “lament of people”

H0501I.name: Elasah
H0501I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0501I.brief: Priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile
H0501I.short: Elasah was a priest who married a foreign woman during the Exile.

H0501J.name: Elasah
H0501J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0501J.brief: Messenger who carried Jeremiah's letter to the exiles
H0501J.short: Elasah was a messenger who carried Jeremiah's letter to the exiles in Babylon.

H0501G.name: Eleasah
H0501G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0501G.brief: Son of Helez, a descendant of Judah
H0501G.short: Eleasah was the son of Helez, a descendant of Judah.

H0501H.name: Eleasah
H0501H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0501H.brief: Descendant of Saul and Jonathan, son of Rapha
H0501H.short: Eleasah, also known as Eshek, was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan, the son of Rapha.

H0511L.name: Elkanah
H0511L.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0511L.brief: A Korahite who joined David at Ziklag.
H0511L.short: Elkanah was a Korahite who joined David at Ziklag while he was fleeing from Saul.

H0511M.name: Elkanah
H0511M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0511M.brief: A gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant.
H0511M.short: Elkanah was appointed as a gatekeeper for the ark of the covenant during its transfer to Jerusalem.

H0511I.name: Elkanah
H0511I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0511I.short: Elkanah was a Levite ancestor of Samuel mentioned in the genealogies.

H0511J.name: Elkanah
H0511J.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H0511J.short: Elkanah was a Levite descendant of Kohath mentioned in the genealogies.

H0511K.name: Elkanah
H0511K.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H0511K.short: Elkanah was a Levite gatekeeper who resided in Jerusalem.

H0511H.name: Elkanah
H0511H.desc: Levite living at the time of United Monarchy
H0511H.brief: The father of the prophet Samuel.
H0511H.short: Elkanah was the father of the prophet Samuel and husband of Hannah.

H0511N.name: Elkanah
H0511N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0511N.brief: A palace officer under King Ahaz.
H0511N.short: Elkanah, the second to the king, was killed by Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, during a battle.

H0511G.name: Elkanah
H0511G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0511G.short: Elkanah was a Levite descendant of Korah, the son of Izhar.

H0508.name: Elpaal
H0508.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0508.short: Elpaal was a Benjamite, the son of Shaharaim, and the founder of several towns.

H0583.name: Enosh
H0583.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H0583.brief: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.
H0583.short: Enosh was the son of Seth, and during his time people began to call upon the name of the Lord.

H0564H.name: Immer
H0564H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0564H.brief: A priestly division and its descendants.
H0564H.short: Immer was the name of a priestly division during the time of David, and his descendants served as priests in the post-exilic period.

H0564G.name: Immer
H0564G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H0564G.brief: A priestly family in post-exilic Jerusalem.
H0564G.short: The descendants of Immer were a priestly family who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile, as recorded in 1 Chronicles and Nehemiah.

H0564J.name: Immer
H0564J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0564J.brief: Man who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall
H0564J.short: Immer was one of the people who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H0566G.name: Imri
H0566G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0566G.brief: A descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem.
H0566G.short: Imri, a descendant of Perez from the tribe of Judah, was among those who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H0566H.name: Imri
H0566H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0566H.brief: Father of Zaccur, helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall.
H0566H.short: Imri was the father of Zaccur, who helped rebuild the wall of Jerusalem.

H0538.name: Amam
H0538.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Judah.
H0538.short: Amam, a town in the Negev region of Judah.

H0549G.name: Amana
H0549G.brief: A mountain range mentioned in the Song of Solomon.
H0549G.short: Amana, a mountain range featured in a poetic description of the beloved's beauty.

H0522.name: Ammah
H0522.brief: A hill near Gibeon, where Joab pursued Abner.
H0522.short: Ammah, a hill near Giah on the way to the wilderness of Gibeon.

H0588.name: Anaharath
H0588.brief: A border town in the territory of Issachar.
H0588.short: Anaharath, a town on the border of Issachar's territory.

H0500.name: Elealeh
H0500.brief: Moabite city assigned to Reuben; later prophecies of destruction
H0500.short: Elealeh, a Moabite city assigned to the tribe of Reuben, later featured in prophecies of Moab's destruction.

H0512.name: Elkosh
H0512.short: Elkosh, the hometown of the prophet Nahum, probably located in Judah.

H0514.name: Eltekeh
H0514.brief: City in Dan's territory; later given to the Levites
H0514.short: Eltekeh, a city in Dan's territory that was later given to the Levites.

H0515.name: Eltekon
H0515.brief: City in the hill country of Judah
H0515.short: Eltekon, a city in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to Judah.

H0513.name: Eltolad
H0513.brief: A town allotted to Judah and Simeon
H0513.short: Eltolad, a town allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Negev region.

H0507.name: Haeleph
H0507.brief: A town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.
H0507.short: Haeleph was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin (<ref="Joshua 18:28">Joshua 18:28</ref>).

H0564I.name: Immer
H0564I.brief: A place from which exiles returned to Jerusalem
H0564I.short: Immer, a place from which exiles returned to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezra 2:59; Nehemiah 7:61">Ezra 2:59; Nehemiah 7:61</ref>).

H0516.name: Al-taschith
H0516.brief: Musical or literary term in Psalms, meaning "Do Not Destroy"
H0516.short: Al-taschith, meaning "Do Not Destroy," appears in the titles of Psalms 57, 58, 59, and 75, possibly indicating a musical or literary term.

H0528.name: Amon
H0528.brief: Egyptian god; city in Nahum, probably Thebes
H0528.short: Amon, mentioned in <ref="Jeremiah 46:25; Nam.3.8">Jeremiah 46:25; Nam.3.8</ref>, refers to the Egyptian god Amon and the city of Thebes, respectively.
